description: This file defines an interface for managing reentrant sections within Orleans grains, allowing requests with the same ReentrancyId to re-enter a grain.

classes.name: ICallChainReentrantGrainContext
classes.description: Interface providing methods to mark the start and end of reentrant sections within a grain.

methods.name: OnEnterReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a reentrant section within a grain, allowing requests with the same ReentrancyId to re-enter.

methods.name: OnExitReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the end of a reentrant section within a grain.
